items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mr. Blakeney, I think before Prez Bailey, there was another person who was the first president of the colored musicians union...

ctx.x: Something like that, yes. Valaida Snow; I don't remember too much about her personally. I don't remember ever working with her.
Mr. Blakeney, I think before Prez Bailey, there was another person who was the first president of the colored
musicians union as it was called. Incidentally, I know the address there was 1710 South Central Avenue.
